summary: Build practical HR privacy skills in data mapping, risk assessment, retention, and monitoring. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Employee data privacy training helps HR, privacy, compliance, and people-analytics practitioners map how employee information is handled. Participants build an employee-data inventory, review purposes and collection needs, and assess access, retention, workplace monitoring, and supplier risks. Exercises also cover employee requests and incident records, while AI-enabled HR processing is addressed at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who manage, advise on, secure, or analyse employee information across HR systems and employment processes.
modules: NIST Privacy Framework and HR Data
NIST Privacy Reporting and HR Action Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with HR processes and routine handling of employee or applicant records is recommended. No coding or programming is required; bring a laptop with access to Excel and a document editor for the exercises.
